subject: Chemistry

Chapter 2: Acids, Bases and Salts.
Acid + Metal -> Salt + Hydrogen gas (Pop sound test).
Strong acid: HCl, H2SO4, HNO3. Weak acid: CH3COOH.
pH of pure water = 7. Acidic: < 7, Basic: > 7.
Chlor-alkali process: 2NaCl + 2H2O -> 2NaOH + Cl2 + H2.
Bleaching powder: Ca(OH)2 + Cl2 -> CaOCl2 + H2O.
